skill.name: grill-me
skill.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
skill.summary: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive from Markdown backticks around a slash command reference in SKILL.md. No executable code, prompt injection attempt, network access, credential access, or data exfiltration intent was found.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 7 uses Markdown backticks to format the text /grilling as an inline command reference. There is no shell syntax, executable script, or user-controlled command execution path.

content.value_statement: Plans and designs often fail because weak assumptions are found too late. This skill starts a focused grilling session that challenges gaps before execution begins.
actual_capabilities: Starts a `/grilling` session in compatible AI tools.
Frames the assistant as a relentless interviewer for plans or designs.
Helps expose assumptions, unclear goals, and weak tradeoffs.
Supports focused critique before implementation or presentation.
Works as a lightweight prompt-only skill without bundled scripts.
limitations: It does not provide its own scoring rubric or checklist.
It depends on the connected tool understanding the `/grilling` command.
It does not validate facts or market data by itself.
It is not a replacement for expert legal, security, or financial review.

use_cases.title: Challenge a Product Proposal
use_cases.description: Use the grilling session to test user assumptions, success metrics, and launch risks before review.

use_cases.title: Stress-test a Technical Design
use_cases.description: Probe architecture choices, dependency risks, and maintenance tradeoffs before engineering work begins.

use_cases.title: Prepare for a Stakeholder Review
use_cases.description: Practice answering hard questions about priorities, costs, and expected outcomes before the meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Plan Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a short plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a `/grilling` session on this plan. Focus on unclear goals, missing constraints, and the riskiest assumption.

prompt_templates.title: Design Critique
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a design direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a `/grilling` session on this design. Challenge the target user, key tradeoffs, failure modes, and launch readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Decision Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before choosing between options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a `/grilling` session on these options. Force a clear recommendation and identify what evidence would change the decision.

prompt_templates.title: Executive Pressure Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for a high-stakes review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a `/grilling` session as a skeptical executive sponsor. Question scope, risk ownership, measurable value, and fallback plans.

output_examples.input: Review a proposed onboarding redesign before the team commits to build work.
output_examples.output: The session asks why the redesign is needed, which activation metric should improve, and what evidence supports the chosen flow.

output_examples.input: Prepare a technical migration plan for leadership review.
output_examples.output: The session challenges the rollback plan, operational ownership, dependency risk, timeline confidence, and success criteria.

output_examples.input: Evaluate whether a new product idea is ready for customer validation.
output_examples.output: The session probes the customer segment, painful problem, validation method, expected objections, and decision threshold.

best_practices: Provide the plan, audience, constraints, and decision deadline before starting.
Ask for direct criticism and concrete follow-up questions.
Use the final answers to revise the plan before sharing it.
anti_patterns: Do not use it with vague ideas that lack goals or context.
Do not treat critical questions as a final expert verdict.
Do not skip human review for regulated, legal, or safety-sensitive decisions.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It starts a focused grilling session that challenges a plan or design with hard questions.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run code?
faq.answer: No. The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable scripts.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide your plan, target audience, constraints, risks, and the decision you need to make.

faq.question: Can it verify external facts?
faq.answer: No. It can challenge reasoning, but separate fact checking is still needed.

faq.question: Why use a grilling session?
faq.answer: It finds weak assumptions early, when the plan is still easy to improve.
